rateModel.title: Two-slope borrow rate curve
rateModel.subtitle: Live parameters from get_rate_params, current utilization and smoothed rate from get_rate_model_diagnostics, and recent utilization samples from get_utilization_history.
rateModel.inactiveBannerTitle: Rate model inactive — default APR applies
rateModel.inactiveBannerBody: rate_model_active is false on the contract. Borrow positions accrue at the fixed default rate of 5.00% APR (500 bps) instead of the two-slope curve.
rateModel.summaryActive: At {utilization} utilization, the target borrow rate is {targetRate} ({targetBps} bps) and the applied smoothed rate is {appliedRate} ({appliedBps} bps). The kink is at {kink} utilization.
rateModel.summaryInactive: The dynamic rate model is currently inactive. The protocol applies the default borrow rate of {defaultRate} ({defaultBps} bps) regardless of utilization ({utilization}).
rateModel.historySubtitle: Newest-first ring buffer (up to 256 ledger samples)
rateModel.historyEmptyBody: The contract returns an empty ring buffer until a borrow-rate update writes the first utilization sample on-chain.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: StellarLend is an over-collateralised lending market on Stellar. Users supply assets to earn interest and borrow other assets against their collateral. Core logic is implemented as Soroban smart contracts; this web app is the user interface.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.step1: Install the Freighter wallet and switch it to Testnet.
gettingStarted.step2: Fund your account with the Stellar testnet friendbot.
gettingStarted.step3: Open Markets and click Connect Freighter. Without a wallet the app runs in demo mode.
gettingStarted.step4: Pick an asset, then Supply, Borrow, Withdraw or Repay.

riskParameters.title: Risk parameters
riskParameters.body: Each asset has a loan-to-value (LTV) ratio. Your borrowing limit is the sum of collateral value times LTV. The health factor is borrowing limit divided by borrowed value; below 1.0 a position becomes liquidatable.

flashLoans.title: Flash loans
flashLoans.body: Flash loans transfer assets to a receiver contract and invoke its on_flash_loan callback. The receiver must repay the principal plus the fee within the same transaction. Visit the Flash loans page to inspect recent loan and repayment events, the maximum flash utilization, and the current pause state.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.body: Next.js 15 (App Router) front end, Freighter for signing, Horizon for balances, Soroban RPC for contract calls. Position state in this build is a local demo ledger; contract invocation is configured through environment variables.

footer.notice: StellarLend runs on Stellar testnet. No real funds. Not financial advice.

flashLoans.title: Flash loans
flashLoans.subtitle: Recent callback-based loans and repayments recorded by the StellarLend lending contract.
flashLoans.maxUtilizationHint: Maximum loan as a share of available treasury liquidity.
flashLoans.pauseHint: Pause state read from the lending contract.
flashLoans.feeHint: {amount} tokens on the latest loan; derived from its event.
flashLoans.feeHintEmpty: Fee is calculated from the latest loan event, not a contract getter.
flashLoans.precisionHint: Amounts use Stellar token precision (7 decimal places).

empty.title: No flash-loan activity found
empty.body: The RPC only retains a limited window of contract events. Activity may be unavailable if there are no recent flash loans or the relevant ledgers have expired from RPC retention.

callback.title: Receiver callback
callback.body: The lending contract invokes this method on the receiver during a flash loan. Implement repayment of principal plus fee in your receiver contract.
